cues.en: Before Retro City Rampage, I was developing another game, a real eight bit game which ran on the real thing.
cues.zh: 在《Retro City Rampage》之前，我在开发另一款游戏，一款真正的八位游戏，能在真机上运行。

cues.en: My focus shifted though as I became less interested in battling the hardware limitations and more in creating the best possible game.
cues.zh: 不过我的重心转移了，我不再那么执着于对抗硬件限制，而是更专注于打造尽可能最好的游戏。

cues.en: So I shelved it and started working on RCR.
cues.zh: 于是我把它搁置了，开始着手 RCR。

cues.en: However, after completing that, I decided to dig it up again, and now you'll be able to see what really was possible in the eighties and how a real eight bit game is made.
cues.zh: 不过，完成那之后，我决定再次把它挖出来，现在你们将能看到八十年代真正能做到什么，以及一款真正的8位游戏是如何制作的。

cues.en: So what are we dealing with here? The six five zero two eight bit CPU running at 1.78
cues.zh: 那我们在这里面对的是什么？六五零二八位CPU，运行频率1.78

cues.en: megahertz.
cues.zh: 兆赫兹。

cues.en: This was used in the Apple two, the Commodore 64,
cues.zh: 这曾在Apple II和Commodore 64上使用，

cues.en: and, of course, the NES.
cues.zh: 当然，还有 NES。

cues.en: 10 kilobytes of RAM, a two k base with eight k extended,
cues.zh: 10 KB 内存，2 KB 基础内存加 8 KB 扩展内存，

cues.en: 32 k of program ROM at a time for both code and data,
cues.zh: 一次32k程序ROM，同时用于代码和数据，

cues.en: four k of sprite graphics ROM at a time, and a whopping 256
cues.zh: 一次四K的精灵图形ROM，以及高达256

cues.en: k of background graphics ROM, thanks to the cartridge hardware.
cues.zh: 得益于卡带硬件，背景图形 ROM 的 k。

cues.en: To make the most of the system's limited memory and speed, tile based graphics are used.
cues.zh: 为了充分利用系统有限的内存和速度，采用了基于图块的图形。

cues.en: Images are broken up into eight by eight pixel tiles,
cues.zh: 图像被分成 8x8 像素的小块，

cues.en: and duplicates are discarded.
cues.zh: 重复项会被丢弃。

cues.en: As a result, the required ROM and RAM size is much smaller.
cues.zh: 因此，所需的ROM和RAM大小要小得多。

cues.en: The background can use up to 13 colors at once, but being only two bits per pixel, the tiles are actually just four colors.
cues.zh: 背景一次最多可用 13 种颜色，但由于每像素只有两位，瓦片实际上只有四种颜色。

cues.en: This is where the palette comes in. While each eight by eight tile can only use four different colors,
cues.zh: 这就是调色板发挥作用的地方。虽然每个 8x8 的图块只能使用四种不同的颜色，

cues.en: which four colors it uses can be selected from up to four palettes.
cues.zh: 它使用哪四种颜色，最多可以从四个调色板中选择。

cues.en: Each palette has three unique colors and a shared background color.
cues.zh: 每个调色板有三种独有颜色和一个共享背景色。

cues.en: Note that when a game is labeled as eight bit, it's referring to the CPU.
cues.zh: 注意，当一款游戏被称为 8 位时，指的是它的 CPU。

cues.en: Eight bit systems generally only supported two bit or four bit color.
cues.zh: 8 位系统通常只支持 2 位色或 4 位色。

cues.en: Eight bit color was something of the 16 bit and VGA era and actually gives you a whopping 256
cues.zh: 8 位色算是 16 位和 VGA 时代的产物，实际上能给你高达 256

cues.en: colors.
cues.zh: 种颜色。

cues.en: The world in RCR used nearly 30,000 tiles, but this needed to be under 8,000.
cues.zh: RCR 里的世界用了近 30,000 个图块，但需要压到 8,000 个以下。

cues.en: I could either heavily simplify the graphics or reduce the size of the world, and so that's what I did.
cues.zh: 我本可以大幅简化图形，或者缩小世界规模，于是我选择了后者。

cues.en: The easiest tiles to cut are those which are only used once. For example, store signs, statues, or foliage.
cues.zh: 最容易砍掉的图块是那些只使用一次的，比如商店招牌、雕像或植被。

cues.en: There also weren't enough sprites for the dynamic props.
cues.zh: 动态道具的精灵图也不够用。

cues.en: And finally,
cues.zh: 最后，

cues.en: I had to simplify the sidewalk pattern to repeat a single tile instead of multiple ones.
cues.zh: 我不得不简化人行道图案，让它重复单个图块，而不是多个图块。

cues.en: It finally fit, and despite the cuts, the majority of the detail still remains.
cues.zh: 它终于塞进去了，而且尽管做了删减，大部分细节仍然保留。

cues.en: I allocated 64 tiles for the character sprites.
cues.zh: 我为角色精灵图分配了 64 个图块。

cues.en: This gave me a three frame walk cycle of 16 directions and seven different character types.
cues.zh: 这让我有了 16 个方向的三帧行走循环，以及七种不同的角色类型。

cues.en: And because you can mirror sprites, you can the same tile for walking left as walking right,
cues.zh: 而且因为精灵图可以镜像，向左走和向右走可以用同一个图块，

cues.en: so you can get 16 directions down into just nine sets.
cues.zh: 所以你可以把 16 个方向压缩到仅九组。

cues.en: To crunch further, the north and south walk cycles, normally three frames, could be done with just two also using mirroring.
cues.zh: 为了进一步压缩，南北向行走循环通常需要三帧，但现在只用两帧也能完成，同样借助镜像。

cues.en: And while the sprites could move in 16 directions, if I stored heads only for the primary eight, those nine sets crunched down to five.
cues.zh: 虽然精灵图可以朝 16 个方向移动，但如果我只为主要的八个方向存储头部，那九组就能压缩到五组。

cues.en: Each car is 24 by 24 pixels and can drive in 16 directions.
cues.zh: 每辆车是 24×24 像素，可以朝 16 个方向行驶。

cues.en: We also need two types, a police car and a normal one. Calculated, that adds up to 288
cues.zh: 还需要两种类型：警车和普通车。算下来总共是 288

cues.en: tiles, over twice the limit of one twenty eight. Mirroring the 16 directions to nine brings it down to one sixty two, and ensuring non diagonal
cues.zh: 个图块，超过 128 这个上限的两倍。把 16 个方向镜像成 9 个，能降到 162，并确保非对角

cues.en: use less tiles brings us down to one forty four, but we're still over.
cues.zh: 方向使用更少图块，能降到 144，但还是超了。

cues.en: So to crunch things further, we need to do more than just combine duplicate tiles, we need to combine similar ones as well.
cues.zh: 所以要进一步压缩，不能只合并重复图块，还得合并相似的图块。

cues.en: In this example, the sprite now uses seven unique tiles instead of nine.
cues.zh: 在这个例子中，精灵现在使用 7 个唯一图块，而不是 9 个。

cues.en: Each eight by eight tile is 64 pixels, and if six of those pixels match, they're treated as duplicates.
cues.zh: 每个 8×8 图块是 64 像素，如果其中 6 个像素匹配，就视为重复。

cues.en: You surely remember the sprite flickering, but you might not know why it happened.
cues.zh: 你肯定记得精灵闪烁，但可能不知道原因。

cues.en: Well, there were 64 sprites available, but only a maximum of eight per line. With cars being three sprites wide, more than two results in flicker.
cues.zh: 嗯，当时可用 64 个精灵，但每行最多 8 个。汽车宽 3 个精灵，超过两辆就会闪烁。

cues.en: Interestingly,
cues.zh: 有意思的是，

cues.en: the game's code did the flickering manually.
cues.zh: 游戏的代码是手动实现闪烁的。

cues.en: The system itself just stops rendering after the eighth.
cues.zh: 系统本身在第八个之后就直接停止渲染。

cues.en: With its 1.78
megahertz CPU,
cues.zh: MHz 的 CPU，

cues.en: high level languages such as c plus plus are out of the question.
cues.zh: 像 C++ 这样的高级语言根本不可能。

cues.en: Not a single line of code from RCR could be used. Instead, you're down to the metal with assembly language.
cues.zh: RCR 里没有一行代码能用。只能直接用汇编语言操作硬件。

cues.en: Unsatisfied,
cues.zh: 对此不满意，

cues.en: I wrote a high level assembler to give me the benefits of both worlds and also started writing macros.
cues.zh: 我写了一个高级汇编器，兼得两者优势，还开始编写宏。

cues.en: Macros simplify your code, enabling you to represent multiple lines with just one.
cues.zh: 宏能简化代码，让你用一行就能代替多行。

cues.en: You retain the performance of assembly language while gaining a syntax closer to c.
cues.zh: 既能保留汇编语言的高性能，又能获得更接近 C 语言的语法。

cues.en: I also added many other c like elements to the assembler, making if statements and loops cleaner, adding structs, adding switch and case, and familiar preprocessor
cues.zh: 我还给汇编器加入了许多其他类似 C 的特性，让 if 语句和循环更整洁，还加入了结构体、switch-case 以及大家熟悉的预处理器

cues.en: directives.
cues.zh: 指令。

cues.en: This all saved me a huge amount of time.
cues.zh: 这一切为我节省了大量时间。

cues.en: Note that I actually released the assembler open source many years ago, so if you wanna tinker with it, go right ahead.
cues.zh: 顺便说一下，很多年前我就把这个汇编器开源了，如果你想折腾一下，尽管去试试。

cues.en: How the code is accessed adds another challenge.
cues.zh: 代码的访问方式带来了另一项挑战。

cues.en: You have 32 kilobytes of program ROM, but it's split up into four slots, eight k each. The total ROM size is 512
cues.zh: 你拥有 32 KB 的程序 ROM，但它被分成了四个插槽，每个 8 KB。ROM 的总大小是 512

cues.en: k, but you can only access it eight k at a time by swapping bits and pieces of it in and out of these four slots.
cues.zh: KB，但你一次只能访问 8 KB，必须通过在这四个插槽中换入换出各部分内容来实现。

cues.en: The limited memory adds to the complexity as you'll often exceed a bank's eight k.
cues.zh: 有限的内存增加了复杂度，因为你经常会超出单个 bank 的 8 KB 上限。

cues.en: You'll then need to move code or data from one bank to another and this slows things down because you'll then need to swap its bank in and then out every time you access it.
cues.zh: 这时你就必须把代码或数据从一个 bank 挪到另一个，而这会拖慢运行速度，因为每次访问时你都得把对应的 bank 换入换出。

cues.en: Meet the vertical blank or the V blank.
cues.zh: 这就轮到“垂直消隐”（Vertical Blank，简称 V blank）登场了。

cues.en: Depending on where in the world you were located, your game would run at either 50 or 60 frames per second.
cues.zh: 取决于你所在的地区，你的游戏会以每秒 50 帧或 60 帧运行。

cues.en: Each frame contained two key states.
cues.zh: 每一帧都包含两个关键状态。

cues.en: The first and majority of the frame time was spent while the TV was drawing picture. Pixel by pixel, it draws from top to bottom. Once it reaches the end, the beam moves back up to the top to draw the next frame. On systems such as the NES,
cues.zh: 首先，每一帧的绝大部分时间都花在电视绘制画面上。它从上到下逐像素绘制，一旦到达底部，电子束就会移回顶部准备绘制下一帧。在 NES 这样的系统上，

cues.en: only during this short period at the end of the frame could you change the graphics.
cues.zh: 只有在帧末尾的这一小段短暂时间内，你才能去修改图形数据。

cues.en: There wasn't enough processing power or system memory to draw the entire screen pixel by pixel. However, thanks to the eight by eight pixel tiles, the entire two fifty six by two forty pixel screen was drawn with just 32 by 30 bytes. However, it wasn't powerful enough to even write that many bytes at the end of each frame. Instead, you were mostly limited to just a couple of rows at a time, but this was perfect for the popular side scrollers of the day, making them no coincidence.
cues.zh: 当时没有足够的算力或系统内存来逐像素绘制整个屏幕。不过，多亏了 8x8 像素的图块，整个 256x240 像素的屏幕只需 32x30 字节就能绘制出来。然而，性能甚至孱弱到无法在每帧结束时写入这么多字节。相反，通常一次只能写入几行，但这恰好完美契合了当时流行的横向卷轴游戏，它们的诞生绝非偶然。

cues.en: And still, you got quite a bang for your buck. With a small 32 byte write, you were drawing 2,048
cues.zh: 即便如此，收益也相当可观。只需写入短短 32 字节，就能绘制 2048 个

cues.en: pixels.
cues.zh: 像素。

cues.en: This is the screen scrolling as you see it,
cues.zh: 这是你所看到的屏幕滚动效果，

cues.en: and this is what's really happening as we write one row at a time.
cues.zh: 而这是我们逐行写入时底层实际发生的情况。

cues.en: We pan the scroll register up and down and it loops around displaying as a moving playfield.
cues.zh: 我们上下平移滚动寄存器，它会循环回绕，呈现为一个移动的游戏场景。

cues.en: One major programming challenge was the lack of a debugger.
cues.zh: 编程上的一个主要挑战是缺少调试器。

cues.en: There's no source level debugging, no watch window, no debug renderer, not even printfs.
cues.zh: 没有源码级调试，没有监视窗口，没有调试渲染器，甚至连 printf 都没有。

cues.en: Writing a full emulator and IDE with all of these features would have taken a fair bit of time, so I took a shortcut. I had already written an emulator,
cues.zh: 要编写一个包含所有这些功能的完整模拟器和 IDE 得花不少时间，所以我走了个捷径。我之前已经写过一个模拟器，

cues.en: and the assembler exported map files which show the location in memory of code and data.
cues.zh: 而且汇编器会导出 map 文件，显示代码和数据在内存中的位置。

cues.en: So in my emulator, I wrote functions to pull this out and as the game runs display it. The variables, arrays, and structs.
cues.zh: 于是我在模拟器里写了几个函数提取这些信息，并在游戏运行时显示出来。包括变量、数组和结构体。

cues.en: This effectively gave me a watch window and the ability to render debug shapes.
cues.zh: 这实际上就让我拥有了监视窗口，以及渲染调试图形的能力。

cues.en: I could also hook into functions that analyze the game at specific points.
cues.zh: 我也可以接入在特定时间点分析游戏的函数。

cues.en: While I never got around to adding music playback to the eight bit version, RCR boasts over two and a half hours of authentic music. The music and sound effects for RCR were composed in impulse tracker format using the free tool mod plug tracker.
cues.zh: 虽然我一直没来得及给 8 位版本加入音乐播放，但 RCR 拥有超过两个半小时的原汁原味音乐。RCR 的音乐和音效是使用免费工具 ModPlug Tracker，以 Impulse Tracker 格式创作的。

cues.en: These can be automatically converted to run on hardware using the tool IT to NSF.
cues.zh: 这些内容可以用 IT to NSF 工具自动转换，以便在硬件上运行。

cues.en: The only real potential hiccup comes from the various tempos used by the music to create our widely varied soundtrack.
cues.zh: 唯一真正可能出问题的地方，是音乐使用了各种不同速度来打造我们变化丰富的配乐。

cues.en: If the tempo doesn't nicely match up to the system's frame rate, certain modulated effects could sound incorrect.
cues.zh: 如果速度不能很好地匹配系统帧率，某些调制效果听起来就可能不对。

cues.en: Everything was composed to the accurate specs with two pulse waves,
cues.zh: 一切都是严格按照精确规格、用两个脉冲波创作的，

cues.en: triangle, a noise, and one bit DPCM for samples.
cues.zh: 三角波、一个噪声通道，以及用于采样的 1 位 DPCM。

cues.en: The only place where the specs were bent is in the playback.
cues.zh: 唯一偏离规格的地方是在播放环节。

cues.en: For a better overall experience,
cues.zh: 为了获得更好的整体体验，

cues.en: RCR allows for smoother fades and simultaneous playback of multiple sounds.
cues.zh: RCR 允许更平滑的淡入淡出，并同时播放多个声音。

cues.en: On a real NES, either sounds would need to drop for others to play, or certain channels would need to be reserved for each purpose. For example, the sound effects might use the triangle and noise channels,
cues.zh: 在真实的 NES 上，要么某些声音得停掉，其他声音才能播放，要么需要为每种用途保留特定通道。例如，音效可能会使用三角波和噪声通道，

cues.en: and the music would use the square and DPCM.
cues.zh: 而音乐则会使用方波和 DPCM。

cues.en: Chip tunes are also why the Wii version of RCR is only 10 megabytes.
cues.zh: 芯片音乐也是 RCR 的 Wii 版本只有 10 MB 的原因。

cues.en: Two and a half hours of music crams down into just one and a half megs.
cues.zh: 两个半小时的音乐被压缩到仅 1.5 MB。

cues.en: I wrote most of this eight bit code ten years ago. If I were to write it again today from scratch,
cues.zh: 这段八位代码大部分是我十年前写的。如果今天让我从零重写，

cues.en: I would be able to better design the engine and likely double the frame rate. However, this still gives you a good idea of what was possible back then.
cues.zh: 我就能更好地设计引擎，帧率很可能翻倍。不过，这仍能让你了解当时能做到什么程度。

cues.en: To completely tap into the system, everything must be designed in the most optimized way.
cues.zh: 要完全榨干系统性能，一切都必须以最优化的方式设计。

cues.en: The size of objects alone, for example, could mean the difference between thirty and sixty frames per second.
cues.zh: 比如，仅对象大小一项，就可能决定每秒三十帧还是六十帧。

cues.en: And while it can get very complicated, it's also very fun figuring out how to make everything fit just right, not unlike a game of Tetris.
cues.zh: 虽然过程可能非常复杂，但琢磨如何让一切严丝合缝也非常有趣，就像玩俄罗斯方块一样。

cues.en: With all that taken care of, the game is finally running.
cues.zh: 把这些都处理好之后，游戏终于跑起来了。

cues.en: You can see side by side how it compares to RCR.
cues.zh: 你可以并排看到它与 RCR 的对比。

cues.en: Much less detail but still impressive,
cues.zh: 细节少了很多，但依然令人印象深刻，

cues.en: especially when you realize that it could have actually been released in 1989.
cues.zh: 尤其是当你意识到它本可以在1989年就发售时。
